what: Hovering the four-cell menu that takes the right half of the header widens the menu row to the screen’s full width (50% → 100%) over .5s ease, and the cell under the pointer opens to twice the other cells (flex 1 → 2). The panel below a cell (link group·card) appears at .4s after holding .35s, and disappears at .1s when you leave. The 1px lines between cells overlap and read as one line

options.--fx-drop-delay: Time before the spread appears, default .35s
options.[data-fx-part=drop]: (If any) expansion below the cell — place it inside the cell

note: No expanding on touch screens (hover: none) — the original also uses a different menu (hamburger) on phones

from.where: shared.js header .tk-head__menu (four slots About, Process, Design, Contact — the Process slot expansion is a Swiper fade carousel)
